Clear monthly access

Choose the plan that matches your work.

Shippers post pickups. Drivers can browse open loads free, then pay to bid. No plan adds a booking commission from us. On a solid direct load, one avoided markup can outweigh a year of access — example math, not a promise.

Quality over noise

Why we charge for posting and bidding

Free boards taught the industry that posting can be free and fake. We charge where it reduces junk — then keep rate and terms together so a “good number” still has to explain the real work. You pay for platform access; we do not take a booking cut of the haul you already agreed.

Shippers · $9.99/mo

Post pickups and review offers. Paying to post raises the cost of throwaway and ghost freight. You cannot browse or claim other members’ loads on this plan.

Drivers · browse free, bid paid

See open loads without a card. A driver or fleet plan is required to bid or claim — so serious trucks, not free spam accounts, compete on the work.

No booking commission

Relocation Manager does not add a cut to an agreed booking. Subscription ≠ verified: still check DOT, insurance, and pickup details (Safety Center).
